comment: Castrum Meridianum's BNpcBase 14569: what it did in three retail runs (Connor's Chronofoil capture af05916c (2026-11-09, visit 0.8) and Bob's 9ba7d981 (visit 0.12) and 50e72631 (visit 0.3) of 2026-11-17, all with Duty Support; `questkit sources --duty 15`: its rotation's pace and each action's median amounts). A draft from Bob's Chronofoil captures (50e72631, 9ba7d981, af05916c), not yet checked in game: ContentFinderCondition 15, BNpcBase 14569, BNpcName 2106, level 50, 7663 HP, 9 seen in 3 runs. `players` and `npcs` are the median damage to each, `every` the median time between uses.

actions.comment: 3 uses; 2.7 s cast. Retail (questkit rates, 2026-11-21: 14 casts by 10 of the duty fixtures' NPCs): first 13.4 to 44.6 s after the pull (median 24.6; `first_uses`: each NPC draws one of retail's each fight), `every` 50.9 s (the median of 4 times between one's uses); used by 10 of the 15 that fought past then (`chance` 0.67). Before, the rotation would have cast it 153 times at most over lives retail's cast it 14.
